findings.body: The instruction says `forge next` lists every open must-answer topic, but unchanged `src/forge/nextstep.py:106-111` does not list answers sourced from `agent` or `our default`. Unchanged `src/forge/records.py:278-285` rejects those sources before the strict review. Relying on the list can leave a topic unresolved during the single read-back call and cause the review command to refuse afterward.
findings.title: Correct the claim that forge next lists every open must-answer topic
